title: Giving Termination Notice for a Paystride Payroll Card Program — Employer Portal Terms
content:
## The notice

A termination notice is the employer's own act, and it is recorded together with the early termination fee it carries, debited from the funding balance of the Paystride Payroll Card Program as a fee of the early termination kind pointing to the notice request; an early termination fee that comes to zero is not debited.

## Who may give it, and when

A termination notice is accepted only when the authorized employer contact whose employer portal role is listed in the package's authorized requester roles gives it personally, signing it in the employer portal after the desk has stated its early termination fee; a package change is accepted only from a requester whose role is listed in the package's authorized requester roles, as the base rule provides.

A termination notice is not recorded, and its early termination fee is not fixed, until the program's status is live.

Restated: while the program's status is anything other than live, no termination notice is recorded on it and no early termination fee is fixed for it.

## Signing the notice

The notice is signed with `give_termination_notice_a65df371`, a tool the customer themselves runs: the agent unlocks it and hands it over to the authorized employer contact, who signs the notice in the employer portal.

**Effect.** The notice is recorded today: a termination notice request is registered as scheduled under the contact's portal role, the program's termination notice date is set to today, and, when the early termination fee stated with the notice is above zero, one fee entry of the early termination kind is added to the funding account history pointing to the notice request and the funding balance falls by it. Workers keep their card accounts; the program stays live until its notice period ends. The contact sees the notice reference, the notice date and any fee debited.

### Parameters

- `paycard_program_id` — the reference number of the employer's Payroll Card Program being terminated, as returned by the program lookup for this employer (identifier).
- `requester_role` — the employer portal role of the contact signing the notice, exactly one of: `program_owner` — the contact who owns the program for the employer; `payroll_admin` — a payroll administrator on the employer portal; `hr_generalist` — a human resources user of the portal; `finance_viewer` — a finance user with view-only access.
- `early_termination_fee_usd` — the early termination fee stated with the notice, in US dollars, zero or a positive number with 2 decimal places; a value with more places is rounded half up to the cent before it is booked.

### Return

A line beginning "Termination notice recorded" indicates the notice was booked. It gives the notice request reference (a text identifier), the notice date (YYYY-MM-DD), the requester role, the early termination fee entry reference (or none when no fee was debited), the fee debited (US dollars, two decimal places) and the funding balance afterwards (US dollars, two decimal places).

### Contract illustration (hypothetical)

Signed with `early_termination_fee_usd` of 0, the notice is recorded with no fee entry and the returned line shows the fee entry reference as none.
